events.title: Space Foundation Family Star Party — Voyager 1 One-Light-Day Anniversary
events.location: Space Foundation Discovery Center, 4425 Arrowswest Drive, Colorado Springs, CO 80907, USA
events.cost: Organizer confirms FREE admission and FREE telescope viewing; mandatory admission for two adults and three children $0. Transport/parking, if any, not established; ordinary daytime museum admission is separate.
events.age: All ages/families, public; no membership requirement or registration requirement stated in the official November 18 event notice; space is not guaranteed.
events.description: Special one-evening after-hours public astronomy gathering commemorating the Voyager 1 spacecraft reaching approximately one light-day from Earth, unlike routine lectures. Hands-on activity about the spacecraft's Golden Record inside the Discovery Center plus direct outdoor telescope observing with Colorado Springs Astronomical Society; the actual Voyager spacecraft is not visible through the telescopes. Official organizer confirms Wednesday Nov 18 2026 6–8 PM, general-public free entry and telescope use. 2026 Colorado-resident friends only (before prospective Jun 2027 family arrival). Telescope observations are weather dependent. Event-specific RSVP/maximum occupancy and parking fee are not stated. Not found in accessible GitHub indexed inbox/search records; no assertion about live Worker DB or delivery.
